content.text: Final rebuild EXIT=0. Now recompile consumer and compute final hashes.

content.name: run_code
content.arguments:
{"code": "
const r = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Final consumer compile and hashes", command: `
lake env lean -j1 -R "D:\\lean" tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1960Consumer.lean 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1960Consumer.log | Out-String
"CONSUMER_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"
$f = "D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1960QPilotAnchorActual.lean"
$o = "D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1960QPilotAnchorActual.olean"
"LEAN_SHA256=" + (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $f).Hash
"LEAN_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $f).Length
"LEAN_TOTAL_LINES=" + ((Get-Content $f).Count)
"OLEAN_SHA256=" + (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $o).Hash
"OLEAN_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $o).Length
"OLEAN_PATH=" + $o
"OLEAN_LASTWRITE=" + (Get-Item $o).LastWriteTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssK")
`, workdir: "D:\\lean", timeoutMs: 900000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? r.stdout.text + "\nSTDERR:\n" + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));
", "description": "Final consumer compile and artifact hashes"}
